question: Daerah asal mana yang memiliki jumlah masakan di bawah rata-rata jumlah masakan per daerah? Tampilkan nama daerah dan total masakannya.
generated_sql: SELECT asal_daerah, COUNT(kode_masakan) AS total_masakan FROM masakan GROUP BY asal_daerah HAVING COUNT(kode_masakan) < (SELECT AVG(jumlah_masakan) FROM (SELECT asal_daerah, COUNT(kode_masakan) AS jumlah_masakan FROM masakan GROUP BY asal_daerah) AS subquery);
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT asal_daerah, COUNT(*) AS total_masakan
FROM masakan
GROUP BY asal_daerah
HAVING COUNT(*) < (
  SELECT AVG(jml)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS jml
    FROM masakan
    GROUP BY asal_daerah
  ) AS sub
);
